observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR camera body with 'Canon' and 'EOS 600D' visible on the front right.
The camera is paired with a Canon EF-S 18-55mm lens, which is labeled on the front of the lens.
The lens cap is on, and the camera body has a textured grip.
Photo 1 shows the rear of the camera, with the LCD screen folded back, and the same lens on the left.
Photo 2 shows the same camera and lens on a shelf, alongside another camera (Canon 700D) and a Nikon lens.
The camera body appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust, especially on the grip and around the buttons.
The lens has visible wear and smudges, especially on the front element.
The seller claims the camera is 'very neat and sharp', but the photos show signs of use and minor wear.

claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera
claims.evidence: Model name 'EOS 600D' is visible on the camera body in photo 0 and photo 1.
Photos show minor scuffs and dust on the grip and lens, and the lens has visible wear. No close-up of the sensor or lens elements to verify sharpness.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens front element and rear element, and a video showing the lens focusing and aperture opening.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential internal damage

risks.risk: Sensor may be scratched or dirty
risks.proof: Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed, or a video showing the sensor under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor with possible scratches

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the battery charging and powering the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing battery and charger

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens front and rear elements.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
